regions.region: page 1 title, authors, citation metadata, and abstract
regions.finding: Verified the source title, DOI/citation, authors, and aggregate claims for Pd/Co-catalyzed hydrophosphinylation of allenes, 1,3-enynes, and dienes. The abstract is a summary, not a set of additional experiments.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and cited prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Classified earlier asymmetric hydrophosphinylation/hydrophosphination and stereodivergent catalysis as prior/context work. No cited external experiment was promoted to a current-paper run.

unresolved: The abstract gives aggregate selectivity, time, catalyst, and TON claims rather than experiment-specific complete conditions.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1a-b
regions.finding: Visually classified Scheme 1a as cited/known asymmetric hydrophosphinylation and Scheme 1b as known conceptual synergistic stereodivergent catalysis; neither is a current experiment.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1c
regions.finding: Classified the allene, enyne, and diene branches as one current generic design. Concrete rows are represented by later Table/Scheme records, and no generic-arrow yield was invented.

regions.region: page 2 lower Results and Discussion optimization narrative
regions.finding: Mapped L1/L2 and L5-L12 ligand comparisons, masked reagents 2a/2a-2/2a-3, room-temperature entries, and ent-L2 mismatch to the fourteen Table 1 rows on page 3. SI-only base/solvent screens were not inferred.

unresolved: Additional base/solvent evaluations are said to be in SI, but no associated SI is available.
The narrative does not add row-specific workup, purification, or mass details.

regions.region: page 3 left Table 1 reaction header, ligand/reagent structures, entries 1-14, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization rows independently with shared 1a/2 charges, catalyst/ligand/base/solvent/time/temperature, 0.1 mmol scale, NMR versus isolated yield basis, dr/HPLC ee bases, n.d./trace, room-temperature overrides, and ent-L2. The -84% sign is retained separately from the valid 84% quantity.

regions.region: page 3 right Scheme 2 reaction header, products 3a-3o, X-ray inset, caption, and footnote a
regions.finding: Recorded every distinct allene-scope row. Standard 3a is merged with Table 1 entry 13; 3b-3o are separate scope records. Product-specific isolated yields, dr, rr, ee, measurement bases, and 3o's explicit 0.4 mmol 2a dose are retained; omitted ee values for 3n/3o remain missing.

regions.region: page 3 lower scope narrative
regions.finding: Mapped substrate-class discussion to the existing Scheme 2 rows without creating prose duplicates. X-ray of 3e (CCDC 2323520) is characterization context, not a second preparation.

unresolved: Table 1 and Scheme 2 omit solvent volumes, atmospheres, workups, purifications, and isolated masses.
3n and 3o have no printed ee value.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 3 products 3p-3u and caption
regions.finding: Recorded six independent phosphine-oxide scope experiments using Scheme 2 conditions, with isolated yields and product-targeted dr/rr/ee values and analytical bases.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 4 deracemization products 4a-4c
regions.finding: Recorded three separate enantioconvergent hydrophosphinylation experiments with doubled catalyst/ligand loadings, (S)-BINAP, 50 °C/12 h, isolated yields, dr/rr, and ee.

regions.region: page 4 middle-right Scheme 4 one-pot sulfide products 5a-5c
regions.finding: Recorded three independent one-pot sequences as ordered 12 h room-temperature hydrophosphinylation followed by Lawesson-reagent sulfuration. Missing second-stage dose/time/temperature remain explicit.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right short-time narrative
regions.finding: Linked the stated 3 min 3a/3b/3f/3i/3j/3q demonstrations to the Scheme 5 records on page 5; no additional narrative experiments were created.

unresolved: Second-stage sulfuration details are not printed.
Scheme 3/4 omit solvent volumes, atmosphere, workup, purification, and masses.

regions.region: page 5 left Scheme 5 short-reaction-time panel
regions.finding: Recorded six independent 3 min experiments (3a, 3b, 3f, 3i, 3j, 3q) with isolated yields, dr/rr, ee, and the caption's NMR/HPLC bases.

regions.region: page 5 left Scheme 5 low-catalyst-loading panel and prose
regions.finding: Recorded three distinct low-loading runs with yields/selectivities and TON values. Preserved the source expression difference between 0.05 mol% [Pd(allyl)Cl]2 in the image/prose and 0.1% Pd catalyst in the caption.

regions.region: page 5 right Scheme 6 1,3-enyne scope products 7a-7d
regions.finding: Recorded four independent 1,3-enyne hydrophosphinylations under the displayed 0.1/0.2 mmol, Pd/L8, Co/L2, n-BuOH, 30 °C, 24 h conditions. The figure does not state the yield basis, which remains missing.

regions.region: page 5 right Scheme 6 stereodivergent map and diene panel
regions.finding: Merged standard 7a with the identical (R,S)-7a branch and recorded the other three ligand-configuration stereoisomer experiments separately without importing SI-only conditions. Recorded the displayed 1.6-equivalent diene run and the prose-reported 2.0-equivalent variant as distinct rows.

unresolved: Low-loading source expression: 0.05 mol% Pd dimer versus caption wording 0.1% Pd catalyst.
Stereodivergent detailed conditions are referred only to unassociated SI.
Scheme 6 yield basis and the diene reaction time are not printed.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of Scheme 6 scope/stereodivergence/diene discussion
regions.finding: Confirmed the 7a-7d identities, stereodivergent ligand logic, and the distinct 1.6 versus 2.0 equivalent 2a diene outcomes. No repeated prose row was duplicated.

regions.region: page 6 upper-right Scheme 7a gram-scale and downstream-transformation arrows
regions.finding: Recorded the 4 mmol/0.92 g/63% gram-scale run and five independent transformations to 5a, 10, 11, 12, and 13. Reagent order and 70 °C RCM temperature are explicit; missing doses/times remain null. Preserved the figure/prose starting-label conflict (1b versus 1a).

regions.region: page 6 lower-right Scheme 7b kinetic-resolution arrow and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Merged the standard 3a/71% experiment into Table 1 entry 13 and added recovery of (S)-2a (50%, 96% ee, X-ray/CCDC 2381594). Preserved >99% versus 99% ee as separate source statements.

regions.region: page 6 lower two-column control-experiment prose
regions.finding: Recorded separate no-Co and no-Pd controls. Page 6 supplies the mechanistic interpretation, 1.2:1 dr/44% ee, and no-reaction statement; the following Scheme 8a image was consulted only as context for the explicit 46% and n.d. labels.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right beginning of deuterium-labeling prose
regions.finding: Recorded the MeOH-d4 hydrophosphinylation (3a-d, 65%, 94% D) and the distinct 2a H/D-exchange control (92% D after 3 min without 1a). The following Scheme 8b image was consulted only to complete the already-started page-6 statements; page 7 is not claimed as covered.

unresolved: Scheme 7 gram-scale substrate label conflicts: image 1b versus prose 1a.
Standard 3a ee display differs: >99% in Table 1/Scheme 2 versus 99% in Scheme 7b.
Control/deuterium runs omit several yield bases, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, isotope methods, and detection limits.
